name: Arcane Feedback
summary: In Ironforge, High Priest Rohan directs human acolytes visiting Khaz Modan to seek their own teachings in Stormwind. The journey brings them to the Cathedral of Light, where human priests learn the traditions of their people.

sections.title: A Gentle Redirection
sections.body: High Priest Rohan welcomes a human priest seeking deeper spiritual teaching in Ironforge’s Mystic Ward. Dwarven and human priests both serve the Holy Light, yet each people has its own rites, disciplines, and prayers of defense. Rohan keeps Ironforge’s teachings for his own clergy and sends human priests back to Elwynn, where they can learn the traditions of humankind.

sections.title: Return to the Cathedral
sections.body: After reaching Stormwind City, the acolyte finds High Priestess Laurena in the Cathedral of Light. Laurena is relieved to see Rohan’s guidance reach the traveler, and welcomes them as their powers begin to grow. At the Cathedral, human priests can continue learning the spiritual practices of Stormwind and prepare to wield the Holy Light against the threats around the kingdom.

faq.q: Why does High Priest Rohan refuse to teach human priests?
faq.answer: High Priest Rohan respects human practitioners, but dwarven clergy keep rites and blessings handed down through their own cultural lineage. He sends human priests to learn the teachings their mentors preserve in Stormwind.
High Priestess Laurena leads and trains priests in the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind City. She guides promising human priests through their intermediate studies and rites.

faq.q: Where can High Priest Rohan be found?
faq.answer: High Priest Rohan can be found in the Hall of Mysteries, in Ironforge’s Mystic Ward.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: This is a guiding step for intermediate human priests, directing them from dwarven lands to the Cathedral of Light, their main place of racial training. There they can pursue spiritual teachings shaped for their people.

angles.text: As a priest, you learn that different peoples follow the Holy Light through their own traditions.
As a human priest, you are sent from dwarven sanctuaries back to Stormwind to learn the sacred ways taught at the Cathedral of Light.
As a dwarf, you can honor your alliance with humans while keeping Khaz Modan’s specific rites among your own people.
